service.description: End-to-End Automated Release Metadata Reconciler: 1. Resolves all component version shifts from maarg-docker-config (myaddons.xml and Dockerfiles) between fromTag and toTag. 2. Scans GitHub Compare API for all shifted components to extract new entity records (Enumeration, StatusItem, etc.). 3. Fetches live reference data from the reference instance. 4. Compares with local instance database to identify missing records. 5. Flags records introduced in the release as CRITICAL (with the component name that added it). 6. If autoApply=true, commits critical records into the local database inside an atomic transaction.

parameter.name: fromTag
parameter.description: Starting release tag of maarg-docker-config (e.g. v6.4.1 or v6.3.0)

parameter.name: toTag
parameter.description: Target release tag of maarg-docker-config (e.g. v6.4.2 or v6.4.0)

parameter.name: referenceUrl
parameter.description: Base URL of the reference / source instance (e.g. https://krewe-maarg-uat.hotwax.io)

parameter.name: referenceApiKey
parameter.description: Bearer Token or Cookie for reference instance authentication

parameter.name: targetUrl
parameter.description: Optional target instance URL (e.g. https://rails-uat.hotwax.io or https://krewe-maarg.hotwax.io). If omitted or 'local', reconciles against local database.

parameter.name: targetApiKey
parameter.description: Bearer Token or Cookie for target instance authentication

parameter.name: dockerConfigRepo
parameter.description: Docker config repository defining component versions

parameter.name: githubToken
parameter.description: GitHub Personal Access Token (auto-detected from ~/.git-credentials if not provided)

parameter.name: entityList
parameter.description: Comma-separated list of entities to reconcile

parameter.name: autoApply
parameter.description: If true, automatically inserts critical missing records into target instance or local DB

parameter.name: githubRepo
parameter.description: Optional single repo override if bypassing maarg-docker-config

parameter.name: repoPath
parameter.description: Optional local path fallback for docker-config

parameter.name: runAutomatedTests
parameter.description: If true, actively executes discovered component test suites and dry-run smoke tests

parameter.name: testComponentList
parameter.description: Optional comma-separated list of component names to filter test suites execution
